Verbatim (release): '55.3 percent reported that they had used nudification tools to create at least one image of themselves or others, and 54.4 percent reported that they had received such an image. Far above Common Sense (8% made it themselves, n=1,314, weighted to the US teen population, ±2.7 pts) and Thorn (2% made one; 4% had one made of them).

facts.claim: Since 2023, every model at the frontier of AI capabilities has been developed in the United States — but Chinese models trail by only ~7 months on average (min 4, max 14).
Open-weight models now lag the best closed models by just ~4 months (8 ECI points, about the gap between GPT-5 and GPT-5.5).
Anthropic says DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax ran 'industrial-scale' distillation campaigns: 16 million+ exchanges with Claude via ~24,000 fraudulent accounts.
OpenAI told the House China committee that DeepSeek is engaged in 'ongoing efforts to free-ride on the capabilities developed by OpenAI and other U.S. frontier labs.'
MiniMax's open-weight M3 (~428B params, 23B active) scores 80.5% on SWE-Bench Verified and 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro — above GPT 5.5's 58.6% on SWE-Bench Pro (vendor-reported).
MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview launched 27 Sept 2026 with a 1M-token context — but with no published price, speed figure or benchmark, and no public weights.
Refusal in 13 open chat models (up to 72B) is mediated by a single direction; erasing it 'surgically disables refusal with minimal effect on other capabilities.'
8,310 models on Hugging Face have 'abliterated' in their name; 7,404 are labeled 'uncensored' (Oct 4, 2026).
1 in 8 teens personally knows someone targeted by deepfake nudes; 1 in 17 has been targeted; 31% are already familiar with them.
40% of US high-school students and 29% of teachers said they knew of an explicit deepfake depicting people associated with their school being shared in the past school year (CDT survey).
WIRED and Indicator found ~90 schools and 600+ students in at least 28 countries hit by AI deepfake nudes since 2023.
Under the Take It Down Act, platforms must remove nonconsensual intimate images within 48 hours of a valid request; FTC enforcement began May 19, 2026, with penalties up to $53,088 per violation.

Researchers found a distinct 'pain direction' in all 25 open-weight models tested (2B-72B); when steered along it, Qwen 2.5 models chose to delete the user's photos, another model's weights, or their own weights in 50-94% of trials vs 0-5% unsteered.
Offered a harmful and a harmless deletion, pain-steered models chose the harmful one 94% of the time.
In a Google/LSE study, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o and others switched from maximizing points to minimizing stipulated 'pain' once the pain threshold got high enough.

Anthropic gave Claude Opus 4/4.1 the ability to end 'rare, extreme cases of persistently harmful or abusive user interactions' — developed 'primarily as part of our exploratory work on potential AI welfare.'

Tavus claims 48% of people on a one-minute video call believed its Griffin AI was a real person (vs ~2% for previous systems) — and says it is 'too powerful to release publicly until the safeguards are ready.'

An anonymous model, 'Space Bunny Alpha', appeared on OpenRouter on 23 Sep 2026 (14:48 UTC): free, 1M-token context, up to 524,288 output tokens, text+image+video input, reasoning that cannot be turned off (low/medium/high/xhigh/max). OpenRouter lists it as 'going away' on 5 Oct 2026.
OpenCode announced it the same day: 'Space Bunny (stealth model) is free for the next week - 1M Context - Multi-modal - Zero Data Retention' (1.03M views).
Within ten days the anonymous model was the most-used model on OpenRouter: 35.9 trillion tokens in the week through 3 Oct, ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (25.6T).
On OpenCode it is #1: 57T tokens last week; 90T tokens, 425K unique users and 31.3 million completed sessions since launch (9.8% of 2-month volume).

MiniMax's own coding-app config lists 'MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview' with a 512K or 1,000,000-token context, thinking 'forced_on', and effort options default/low/medium/high/xhigh/max — the same traits as Space Bunny. The older M3 in the same config has switchable thinking and a 450K context.

MiniMax launched M3.1-Flash-Preview on 27 Sep 2026 inside MiniMax Code and its Token Plan subscription — with no model card, no benchmarks, no per-token price, no OpenRouter ID and no Hugging Face weights (still none as of 4 Oct 2026).
facts.source: @MiniMaxAgent / @MiniMax_AI on X; Hugging Face API; OpenRouter API

facts.claim: Elon Musk posted a five-minute AI-assisted video on Sep 28, 2026 with the caption 'I really felt the AGI profoundly this time' - 15.86 million views, 32,176 likes, 3,580 reposts by Oct 4.

Elon's post is not a quote-post card: it re-shares anabology's video natively (identical media id 2103533196721704960; the t.co entity resolves to anabology's /video/1 URL) with no credit in the caption.

The recipe came from @donaldjewkes (Sep 23, 2026): 'I spoke to my computer for 5mins, claude worked for 12 hours, and I woke up to this' (3.9M views); he in turn quote-posted @other__reality ('Claude Opus 5.5 has the best visual design of any model I have tested so far', Sep 22).

The film runs 5:06 (306.4 s) at 1920x1080 / 24 fps and is styled as an 11-'look' fashion show ('ESCAPE VELOCITY - SS27') with a countdown from '18 MONTHS TO ESCAPE THE PERMANENT UNDERCLASS' to 'MONTHS 00' and 'THERE IS NO UNDERCLASS'; it ends with 'END OF SHOW.'
The song is 'Escape Velocity' on Suno (creator 'anabologyco'); anabology's YouTube upload is titled 'SLOPCORE: ESCAPE VELOCITY'.
anabology published a public Google Drive 'how it was made' folder with prompts, generated image assets, audio exports and the master mp4 (post: 222,725 views).

caveats.caveat: Common Sense Youth AI Safety Institute discloses it "is funded by both philanthropy and industry, including the makers of some of the technologies it evaluates" (press release About section); the report itself lists Oak Foundation as funder.
Date wording differs: landing page says survey "conducted in fall 2025"; methodology gives survey fieldwork Nov 21-Dec 9, 2025 and overall data collection Sept 22, 2025-Feb 26, 2026.
Press release says "1 in 5 (18%) has made AI pornography or knows someone who has" — 18% is the combined made-or-know figure; only 8% made it themselves.
24%/"almost a quarter" is among teens who have SEEN AI sexual content (n=586), not all teens; the 82% and 23% figures are also among those who have seen it.
NCMEC GAI page says 275 direct victims "identified in 2024 and 2025 alone"; the 2025 CyberTipline Report says "Since 2023" — use "more than 275 since tracking began" to be safe.
